title: The reconcile test tracker counts a re-claim as a new claim; real tk does not
description: Found by #50's author: internal/reconcile/harness_test.go's fake tracker counts a re-claim of an already-claimed tick against the width, which the real tk does not. Tests that depend on width can then pass or fail for a reason production never has. Make the fake match tk's claim semantics and add a test pinning it against tk's own behaviour.
